Cosmetic · Patient guide

Teeth whitening in Gujranwala

Professional whitening lightens the shade of natural teeth after a dental assessment.

Ask about an appointment →

When might I need it?

Discuss whitening if you want to lighten natural teeth. The dentist can explain whether surface cleaning, treatment of a dental problem, or another option is more appropriate.

What age group is it for?

Elective whitening is generally an adult treatment. The dentist assesses existing sensitivity, gum health and restorations before recommending it.

What happens at the appointment?

The dentist checks your teeth, discusses the achievable shade and chooses a suitable approach. Existing fillings, crowns and veneers do not lighten like natural teeth.

Does it hurt?

Temporary sensitivity or gum irritation can occur. Tell the dentist about any history of sensitivity before starting.

How much does it cost?

Ask if the fee covers an in-clinic session or a supervised tray kit, any review appointment, and future top-ups.

For current pricing and availability, ask the clinic for a quote in PKR based on your assessment.

Plan your visit

Ask the team about availability, the consultation fee, and what to bring. Wait for reception to confirm the date and time.
